## Hi, I'm happy you're here

I'm an Associate Professor of Finance at [Merrilee Alexander Kick College of Business and Entrepreneurship, Texas Woman's University](https://twu.edu/business/). My research interest focuses on investments, household finance, and the impact of AI and Fintech on financial decision-making and markets.

## Outside the classroom

Outside the classroom and my research, I'm also a Rubik's cube solver. You can check out my <a href="https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2025RENH02" target="_blank" rel="noopener">World Cube Association (WCA) profile</a> to see my official results, or <a href="#" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#cubeVideoModal">watch my fastest 3x3 solve</a>.

I'm also passionate about photography. You can browse some of my favorite shots in the [Photography](photography.qmd) section of this website.

```{=html}
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const modal = document.getElementById("cubeVideoModal");
    const frame = document.getElementById("cubeVideoFrame");
    if (!modal || !frame) return;
    const src = "https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/rhAZwPB3108?rel=0";
    // Load the video only when the modal opens, and unload it on close so it stops playing.
    modal.addEventListener("show.bs.modal", () => { frame.src = src; });
    modal.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", () => { frame.src = ""; });
  });
</script>
```
